{{Quote|I didn't come here for the ship, child. I came for ''T'orn''. He was planning on making a power play for ''control'' of Black Sun. This theft would have earned him serious support, but he was far too ''unpredictable'' to be allowed to rule.|[[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], to [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]|<ref name="Under the Hammer" />}}
'''T'orn Zorc''' was a [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who made a bid to take control of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. His efforts were [[Mission to Callos|foiled]] by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], who [[Death/Legends|killed]] Zorc on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Callos]].
